WAVEFORM / FIELD NOTES

Behind the interface.

Live spot prices from Binance, OKX and Gate are compared in USDT. Failed providers are shown as unavailable, and quotes expire after 30 seconds. No prices are invented.

The canvas builds theoretical grid levels around the median fresh mid-price. The scenario slider moves a hypothetical price; crossed levels are not fills. Ideal cycle estimates include two trading fees, but omit spread, slippage and transfer costs.

The AI bot name is a project theme. Calculations are transparent rules and simulations, with no trained AI model or trade execution. Fees are editable assumptions.
